column4: How Blink Orbit handles it
All amounts use en-IN grouping (₹12,34,567 — never 1,234,567) via a single formatting module
Lakh/crore compaction (₹4.56L, ₹2.3Cr) on the orb, chips and share card; whale persona (₹1Cr+) stress-tests it
True minus outside the rupee sign (−₹1,240); losses render red — never hidden or spun
Paise shown only where it matters (live interest meter); rounded elsewhere to avoid false precision
All formatters guard non-finite values to "—" so the UI can never render ₹NaN
New users / all-negative flows return null → UI shows "—" with an explanation, not a fake 0%
Streaks count local calendar days — 11:59 PM and 12:01 AM saves are consecutive days (unit-tested)
A streak stays alive if yesterday was saved; copy explains the 7 AM debit window
Deduplicated by local day key before counting
Best-ever run is shown and copy reframes toward compounding — no shame, no loss-aversion pressure
Streak runs across 31st→1st are unit-tested
Borrow power is ₹0 — progress-to-unlock shown instead of pretend credit

column3: Market crash with an active loan
column4: Simulator states are exact: safe <15%, margin call at −15%, forced sale at −20%, with the top-up that restores LTV (unit-tested)
Simulator says the truth: nothing can be force-sold, the SIP just buys cheaper
ACT/365 day count, negative clock skew clamped to 0, per-second tick only while the screen is mounted
2–4 working day unpledge time stated upfront in the fine-print card — not buried in a PDF
Skeleton loaders on all screens; latency injectable (0/900/3500ms) from the demo panel
Friendly error state that says funds are unaffected + one-tap retry; injected failures auto-heal to prove retry works
Stale snapshot served with a persistent "last synced" banner
Dedicated empty state explaining a snapshot will be kept once online
A request sequence counter drops superseded responses (fast persona switching can't interleave)
Guard flag prevents duplicate capture/share-sheet launches
Sharing.isAvailableAsync checked → graceful fallback message suggesting a screenshot
Treated as a non-event — never shown as an error
Gets an honest "the habit starts tonight" card — no fake numbers to flex
PRIYA51 → "Priya"; empty/invalid codes degrade to a generic invite, never an error screen
Streak milestones use best-ever run — achievements never un-achieve (unit-tested)
Backfill rule: only the newest celebrates, older ones marked silently — no modal spam on persona switch/reinstall
Celebrated ids persist per persona in AsyncStorage
Single honest "quiet month" slide instead of empty celebration
Withdrawal gets a no-guilt "life happened" slide; auto-advance pauses under Reduce Motion (tap-only)
Ranked by consistency (days/30) only, ties by streak — ₹2,001/day cannot outrank ₹21/day by amount
Asset drill-down for an id not in the portfolio shows a graceful "not in your orbit" state
Rubber-band asymptote caps travel — the orb can never be dragged off-screen; horizontal pans fall through to scroll

column3: Haptic spam while holding the slingshot
column4: Arm haptic is edge-triggered once per crossing — never per-frame
Slingshot disabled entirely; tap navigation and accessibility hint adapt
Shared BlinkSlider: UI-thread pan, discrete snapping, threshold markers, screen-reader increment/decrement actions
Dead slider replaced with repay framing; ₹0 priced honestly: "an unused credit line is free, forever"
Pause state persists per persona and auto-expires — a lapsed pause reads as running, never stuck
Copy states invested money keeps compounding and withdrawals stay available; pausing affects future debits only
Honored globally: orbit freezes, count-ups snap, skeletons stop pulsing, confetti skipped, press-scale becomes opacity
Font scaling capped at 1.4× so number-dense rows ellipsize instead of clipping/overlapping
Orb, streak dots, squad rows and all sliders carry descriptive labels; sliders are role=adjustable
Orb clamps 260–360px; safe-area insets respected on notched devices
Contextual only (success vs warning pulse, selection ticks, edge-triggered arm) — never fired in loops
